name: cops
description: Skills for working with pull requests — reviewing, describing, syncing, or otherwise assisting with the PR lifecycle.

PR_MEMORY_REPO.title: PR memory repo
PR_MEMORY_REPO.description: Private git repo (owner/repo or a git URL) that syncs pr-oracle memory across machines. Leave unset to keep memory on this machine only.

PR_MEMORY_LOGIN.title: GitHub login
PR_MEMORY_LOGIN.description: Your GitHub username. Memory sync pushes what you learn to the memory/<login> branch of the memory repo. Leave unset only if the memory repo holds no one else's memory/users/ tree.
